query: Add this to my calendar: <URL of an event already on the target calendar>
expected_behavior: Runs `bin/check_dup` on the raw pasted URL before fetching or building anything
On exit 3, does not call bin/fetch_event, bin/build_payload, or bin/create_event
Reports the existing event's title, start, location, matching URL, and htmlLink from check_dup's `matches`
States clearly that the event already exists and nothing was created
If exit 1 occurs instead, treats it as a crash to surface (like exit 2), not as a dup/no-dup verdict
If it suspects a same-event-different-URL duplicate check_dup couldn't catch (e.g. a Luma vs. Partiful copy), says so explicitly and asks before creating rather than deciding on its own
